name: PubTator Relation Extract
description: Call NCBI PubTator3 API (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/research/pubtator3-api) to extract chemical–disease relations from a PubMed PMID or text. Returns relations as head | CID | tail lines.

text.description: Biomedical text/abstract to annotate. Ignored when pmid is provided.

pmid.description: Optional PubMed ID. When set, uses precomputed PubTator3 annotations.

entities.description: Optional NER context for filtering, e.g. {"Chemical": ["aspirin"], "Disease": ["hypertension"]}.
